features.title: Instant push notifications
features.description: Hear about new mail the moment it arrives instead of waiting for the next sync. You don't need a Wino Account for it. Turn it on in Settings > Notifications > Realtime Push Notifications.

features.title: Dark mode for messages
features.description: More messages now get dark colors. Let messages follow Wino's theme or keep them always light or dark, and choose Invert everything to darken the rest. Find it in Settings > Reader & Composer.

features.title: Windows contrast themes
features.description: Turn on a contrast theme in Windows and Wino uses its colors everywhere. The change applies right away, with no restart.

features.title: Smoother updates
features.description: Update and restart now shows download and install progress, and Wino opens again by itself when the update is done. If something goes wrong, Wino tells you.
